description:
Cut the subprocess query suite to wiring cases, now that the domain owns query semantics.

## Background

`crates/jit/tests/cli_query_graph/query_tests.rs` has 25 subprocess tests (1,422 lines) and 32 `split_whitespace` sites. It re-proves filters and priority order that `crates/jit/src/domain/queries.rs` owns as pure functions. `dev/TESTING.md:619` cites the file as a worked example.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `query_tests.rs` holds at most one case per `query` subcommand and per flag, each asserting that the command reaches the domain query, for example that a filter is applied, and not the query's semantics.
- [hard] REQ-02: Each removed case's property has an owning test in `crates/jit/src/domain/queries.rs` before the case is removed, so no semantic case remains here; the domain owners are added ahead of this change, which adds none itself.
- [hard] REQ-03: The remaining cases spawn `jit` through the shared CLI process fixture, read ids from `--json` output and use the shared `TaxonomyRepo` instead of the suite-root copy.
- [hard] REQ-04: `dev/TESTING.md` describes the reduced suite.
title: Query CLI tests assert one wiring case per subcommand and flag
